explanation: Turmeric is a rhizome of the ginger family, boiled and dried before grinding. Its yellow pigment, curcumin, turns red in alkaline conditions, so a turmeric stain goes red when washed with soap.

claims.text: Turmeric is the spice that gives curry powder its yellow colour.
Saffron is not a usual ingredient of curry powder, cumin is brown and paprika is red, so none gives curry powder its yellow colour.
Turmeric is the rhizome of a plant in the ginger family, which is boiled and dried before being ground into the spice.
Curcumin, turmeric's yellow pigment, turns red in alkaline conditions, so turmeric stains turn red when washed with soap.
